simple.summary: פְּלִילִי (pᵉlîylîy) means judicial First listed occurrence: Job 31 28.

definitions.full: H6416. pelili מְּלִילִי adjective for a judge, calling for judgement ; — פ ׳עָוֺן Job 31:28 (on 31:11 see מָּלִיל Kue ond (2) 161 reads מְּלִילִים עֲוֺן in both v 31:11 and v 31:28 ).
